title: gyro gcsv auto-match on import

commit.merge_subject: merge: gyro gcsv auto-match on import

description:
When a video import finishes and a gyro folder is granted,
AppNav queries the tree for .gcsv logs and runs GyroMatcher on
the imported clip's display name. Exactly one match attaches it
through the Phase 5a path unchanged (GyroStore.import, openFileDescriptor,
jniGyroSyncProbe, size >= 5, setGyro; probe failure removes the
entry) and shows the 'Gyro data attached' snackbar. Multiple
matches open a shell-level dialog listing the candidates; zero
stays silent. A clip that already has a gyro (attached in the
editor) is never overwritten, and the whole match is best-effort:
it runs on the main scope after the import returns, so the
Library's import snackbar never waits on the query, copy, or
probe, and no failure path can fail a successful import.

Grant UX: the first import with no folder shows a dismissible
LONG snackbar hint ('Pick folder' action opens the SAF tree
picker, takePersistable
